title: sessions/{id}/peers/{peerId}/callerCandidates/{id} and calleeCandidates/{id}
description: One ICE candidate of a remote camera's signaling in Firestore (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §10, docs/RTC.md, docs/PLAN.md T4.0), as RTCIceCandidateInit has it, under the peer document of cloud-peer.schema.json: the phone's in callerCandidates, the host's in calleeCandidates. No schema field: the documents are short-lived and have one shape.

candidate.description: The candidate line (candidate:… ), of at most 1,000 characters; empty for the end-of-candidates mark.

createdMs.description: When the device wrote it, in ms, on its clock.
